market_snapshot.reason: Web-rendered exchange responses were observed, but exact raw HTTP response bytes, response headers and receipt hashes were not captured. Kraken event timestamp is unavailable; no synchronized full-depth multi-venue L2 snapshot was retrieved.
market_snapshot.interpretation: OKX and Kraken top-of-book sizes show opposite imbalances (+62.25% vs -69.76%). These are not full-depth books and are not synchronized; the price difference is not executable arbitrage evidence. OKX rolling 24-hour open ($0.991) differs from its UTC day open ($0.9145); Kraken's open field ($0.91378) is close to the UTC-day open, not the rolling 24-hour open. Preserve window semantics.

derivatives.interpretation: Both provider snapshots indicate negative funding, declining open interest and long-side liquidation pressure, but timestamps, exchange coverage and aggregation differ. Do not average OI or liquidations; these snapshots are stale for model admission.

sbi_ownership_reconciliation.denominator_note: SBI says voting rights are calculated against Class A shares; economic interest against total Class A and Class C shares.
sbi_ownership_reconciliation.sec_definition: SBI Group Ownership Percentage is Class A and Class B shares beneficially held by SBI Group Holders divided by Outstanding Voting Shares; 39.9% is also the maximum ownership restriction/cap. SBI Group Holders include SBI Venture Fund 2023A, SBI Venture Fund 2023B, SBI PE Holdings Co., Ltd. and SBI Holdings USA, Inc., each controlled by SBI.
sbi_ownership_reconciliation.reconciliation: 39.9% SEC contractual voting-ownership metric/cap as of October 9 is not the same as SBI's November 2 36.1% voting-rights and 20.5% economic-interest metrics. Class A versus Class A+Class C denominators and subsequent share-count changes differ. The 3.073m warrant exercises through November 9 may affect the denominator, but a complete cap-table bridge was not established; do not infer causality.

evernorth_capital_update.capital_classification: Actual cash, cash used to buy XRP, XRP contributed in kind, SPAC trust cash, debt, warrant proceeds and undrawn/unused ELOC capacity remain separate. The $35.3m warrant proceeds are actual gross cash but not proof of XRP purchases; the $30m note is debt; the ELOC is capacity, not cash.
